payload.rationale: The Chlordane row establishes report-only effluent monitoring with no enforceable numeric discharge limit, not elimination or suspension of monitoring. All numeric limit columns are N/A, so no mass- or concentration-based compliance limit is specified for comparison. The 7-day average concentration column reads 'Report', matching the same Report/N/A pattern used elsewhere in this table for parameters that require reporting without a numeric limit (e.g., Flow 'Report MGD', Total Dissolved Solids 'Report'). Critically, the row also specifies an active monitoring obligation—measurement frequency '1/Quarter' with sample type 'Grab'—which is incompatible with the alternative that monitoring requirements are eliminated or suspended. The row sits in SECTION A 'LIMITATIONS AND MONITORING REQUIREMENTS' under 'FINAL Effluent Limits' for Outfall 001, alongside structurally identical priority-pollutant rows, indicating a standard report-only monitoring entry rather than a waiver.
